dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Let's practice for Mr. Brown's quiz. Who invented the light bulb?
dialogue.reading: ˈlɛts ˈpræktɪs fər ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊnz ˈkwɪz. ˈhuː ɪnˈvɛntɪd ðə ˈlaɪt ˌbʌlb?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The light bulb was invented by Thomas Edison in 1879.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈlaɪt ˌbʌlb wʌz ɪnˈvɛntɪd baɪ ˈtɑːməs ˈɛdɪsən ɪn ˌeɪˈtiːn ˈsɛvənti ˈnaɪn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good! But some people say a British man made one first.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd! bʌt sʌm ˈpiːpəl ˈseɪ ə ˈbrɪtɪʃ ˈmæn ˈmeɪd ˈwʌn ˈfɜːrst.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I didn't know that. OK, my turn. Who invented the steam engine?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈdɪdənt ˈnoʊ ˈðæt. oʊˈkeɪ, maɪ ˈtɜːrn. ˈhuː ɪnˈvɛntɪd ðə ˈstiːm ˌɛndʒɪn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. The first useful steam engine was built by Thomas Newcomen in 1712. James Watt made it better later.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈjuːsfəl ˈstiːm ˌɛndʒɪn wʌz ˈbɪlt baɪ ˈtɑːməs ˈnuːkʌmən ɪn ˌsɛvənˈtiːn ˈtwɛlv. ˈdʒeɪmz ˈwɑːt ˈmeɪd ɪt ˈbɛtər ˈleɪtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You know a lot! What about the compass?
dialogue.reading: juː ˈnoʊ ə ˈlɑːt! ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkʌmpəs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The compass was invented in China more than two thousand years ago.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈkʌmpəs wʌz ɪnˈvɛntɪd ɪn ˈtʃaɪnə ˈmɔːr ðən ˈtuː ˈθaʊzənd ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And the wheel? Who invented the wheel?
dialogue.reading: ənd ðə ˈwiːl? ˈhuː ɪnˈvɛntɪd ðə ˈwiːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No one knows. It was invented more than five thousand years ago.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˌwʌn ˈnoʊz. ɪt wʌz ɪnˈvɛntɪd ˈmɔːr ðən ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd ˈjɪrz əˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The first microscope was made by a father and his son in Holland, around 1590.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈmaɪkrəskoʊp wʌz ˈmeɪd baɪ ə ˈfɑːðər ənd hɪz ˈsʌn ɪn ˈhɑːlənd, əˈraʊnd ˌfɪfˈtiːn ˈnaɪnti.
